<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Quick start</h2><a id="user-content-quick-start" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Quick start" href="#quick-start"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The entry point to this package is the <code>beeswarm</code> recipe, which accepts input the same way <code>scatter</code> does in all respects -- plus a keyword <code>algorithm</code>, which specifies the beeswarm algorithm!</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using SwarmMakie, CairoMakie
ys = rand(150)
beeswarm(ones(length(ys)), ys)"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> SwarmMakie, CairoMakie
ys <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">rand</span>(<span class="pl-c1">150</span>)
<span class="pl-c1">beeswarm</span>(<span class="pl-c1">ones</span>(<span class="pl-c1">length</span>(ys)), ys)</pre></div>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/32143268/311479345-5b422b52-0017-4bd2-8c61-22ad195266b1.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..DcTOOT5zkRn2nvjuyMpe1JAnKH3gL0Y1ZUg8KpHXBes"><img src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/32143268/311479345-5b422b52-0017-4bd2-8c61-22ad195266b1.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..DcTOOT5zkRn2nvjuyMpe1JAnKH3gL0Y1ZUg8KpHXBes" width="600/" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using SwarmMakie, CairoMakie
xs = rand(1:4, 500)
ys = randn(500)
beeswarm(xs, ys; color = xs)"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> SwarmMakie, CairoMakie
xs <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">rand</span>(<span class="pl-c1">1</span><span class="pl-k">:</span><span class="pl-c1">4</span>, <span class="pl-c1">500</span>)
ys <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">randn</span>(<span class="pl-c1">500</span>)
<span class="pl-c1">beeswarm</span>(xs, ys; color <span class="pl-k">=</span> xs)</pre></div>
